description: Zero-dependency Python library to detect, validate, sanitize and extract usernames from social media profile URLs for 65+ platforms (LinkedIn, GitHub, X/Twitter, Instagram, YouTube and more), with support for custom regex-based platforms.
rules: Install with pip install social-links but import from sociallinks (for example: from sociallinks import detect_platform, sanitize).
detect_platform() returns None for a bare username; pass the platform name to is_valid() or sanitize() to check a bare ID.
sanitize() and extract_id() raise URLMismatchError when the URL does not match the named platform.
Use the SocialLinks class for custom platforms; set_platform() raises PlatformAlreadyExistsError unless override=True.
